beats.headline: Hostile on arrival, and reasonable about it
beats.text: Subject took the Fugitive Class and wears a leather jacket, knee-high boots and a black cape. He carries a crossbow. He is covered in tattoos he did not acquire down here. He and his party meet the court while hostile, having heard what a certain cat said about Cat Girls, and the misunderstanding is cleared up faster than anybody expected.

beats.headline: The anvil piece goes out the door
beats.text: Subject is holding the first piece of Ogun's shrine when the music starts, and holds nothing steadily after that. Oshun charms him. He calls out that he is coming, shoulders free of Paz, and throws the piece of his own god's shrine through the temple door and out into the night. When he comes back to himself, half the fingers on his right hand are gone and Sister Ines is standing over him. He goes to work on Legba's shrine instead, until a glob of Asojano's green goo hits him and Paz both. Both men now carry a flaming anvil over their heads: a god's shunned marker.

beats.headline: Under the god's heel
beats.text: Subject is dead. Carl threw Black Nimbus over him, which took Anton out from under Ogun's protection and did nothing whatever about Ogun's wrath. The god considered this, called it a good attempt, took a step backward, and crushed Anton's head underfoot. He had already turned his back on Anton to face Carl when he did it. Paz, bleeding on the floor nearby, called him cousin.
